digests.summary: Aaj major GST aur Ruling updates aaye hain - IGST settlement rules, e-Way Bill enhancements ka hold aur kuch court judgements business process impact kar sakte hain.

items.headline: GST Council notifies IGST Settlement Rules, 2026
items.detail: GST Council ne IGST settlement mechanism ko aur strong karne ke liye naye GST Settlement of Fund Rules, 2026 notify kiye hain. Isse IGST ka distribution process transparent hoga.
items.cga_view: Abhi rules ki copy dekhein, process change ho sakta hai - agar IGST settlements mein regularly deal karte hain to update rahein.

items.headline: GSTN ne naye e-Way Bill rules abhi hold par daale
items.detail: GSTN ne propose kiye gaye e-Way Bill enhancements jo 1 August 2026 se aana tha, abhi next notice tak hold par rakhe hain. Purane process hi follow karo.
items.cga_view: Abhi koi system/process badalne ki zarurat nahi - existing e-Way Bill rules hi applicable hain.

items.headline: Telangana HC waives 10% pre-deposit jab IGST pehle hi pay hua
items.detail: Telangana High Court ne bola ki agar IGST ki payment already ho chuki hai to GSTAT appeal ke liye 10% pre-deposit ki zarurat nahi.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka case similar hai to apne advisor se consult karke waiver ke liye application file karein.

items.headline: GST seized documents par fresh reply allowed: Telangana HC
items.detail: Telangana HC ne GST Section 74 proceedings mein jab seized documents di gayi, toh fresh supplementary reply aur personal hearing ki ijazat di.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke documents seize hue hain toh ensure karein ki sab material mile aur fresh reply ka option use karein.
